description: Report on how conflicting, equal-authority OSM tags are handled.

status_definitions.OFFLINE_CLASSIFICATION_VERIFIED: The classifier successfully resolved a unique semantic class.
status_definitions.AMBIGUOUS: Multiple incompatible semantic classes were matched in the same precedence tier.

behavior_on_ambiguity: Do NOT arbitrarily pick. Return status=AMBIGUOUS along with the list of candidate semantic classes, and matched rules for further manual audit.
